html:
Mozambique is a country on the Indian Ocean coast of south-east Africa, a Portuguese colony until 1975. The map shows it under this name from 1880, when it grew out of the older Portuguese East Africa.

After the Berlin Conference, Portugal set out to rule the whole territory. It defeated the Gaza kingdom in 1895, made Lourenço Marques (now Maputo) the capital in 1898. Africans were made to work on plantations or grow cotton, and many thousands went every year to work in the gold mines of South Africa under a deal between the two governments.

In 1962 exiles founded FRELIMO, the Mozambique Liberation Front, which began a guerrilla war in the north in 1964. After the army overthrew Portugal's dictatorship in 1974, Mozambique became independent on 25 June 1975 under Samora Machel.

FRELIMO set up a Marxist one-party state. White-ruled Rhodesia and then South Africa backed RENAMO, a rebel army, in a civil war from 1977 to 1992 that killed huge numbers of people, many through famine. It has been hit hard by disasters such as the floods of 2000 and Cyclone Idai in 2019.
sum: Mozambique is a country on the Indian Ocean coast of south-east Africa, a Portuguese colony until 1975. The map shows it under this name from 1880, when it grew out of the older Portuguese East Africa.
